scope: Independent cold final rendered UI review only

authority.human_eye_version: V2.0 production certified effective 2026-09-29; fetched directly

professional_assessment: Coherent, readable, well-spaced profile selection and parent handoff. Large profile cards and clear selected/handoff labels work in two-column portrait and four-column landscape layouts. The dialog stays the dominant active surface; error wording and Cancel give a clear recovery path. No confirmed visual defects.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.binding_basis: supplied frozen manifest and verified raster/structure/readable hashes; source code intentionally not read

REGION_COVERAGE.definition: Four full-width non-overlapping raster bands per capture, coordinates in captures; includes full document beyond viewport.

EDGE_GATES.resolution_rule: Rendered visible contour controls. Covered contours resolved as intentional modal occlusion, not structural clearance of hidden artwork.

coverage_receipt.APPLICATION_BINDING: WatchNest actual compiled Chromium synthetic UI at 390x844,768x1024,1024x768; native full-document rasters 390x942,768x1039,1024x775. Picker, Eli handoff, wrong PIN at each width. No hosted/device/authentication claim.

HUMAN_GATES.alignment: PASS — titles, supporting text, cards and modal content follow clear common centers; card rows align at each width.
HUMAN_GATES.optical_centering: PASS — profile symbols sit comfortably inside their circular carriers and the dialog rocket balances its heading.
HUMAN_GATES.spacing_rhythm: PASS — consistent card gutters, internal label gaps and dialog padding; error insertion expands the dialog without crowding Cancel.
HUMAN_GATES.grouping: PASS — each avatar/name/action/status group reads as one large selectable card; parent-only actions are visually separated.
HUMAN_GATES.hierarchy: PASS — question and profile identity dominate picker; target child and PIN field dominate dialog; error is subordinate but distinct.
HUMAN_GATES.crop_story: PASS — visible symbol contours are complete; intentional modal occlusion is accounted for and does not certify hidden artwork.
HUMAN_GATES.contrast: PASS — active text remains readable on ink/cards and dialog; the muted backdrop correctly yields to active dialog. No visible text contrast blocker.
HUMAN_GATES.gestalt: PASS — restrained ink, lavender and peach, rounded carriers and consistent typography form one coherent premium family interface.
HUMAN_GATES.clarity_recovery: PASS — parent instruction explains four-digit handoff and unchanged time limit; incorrect PIN is named explicitly and Cancel remains visible.
HUMAN_GATES.touch_geometry: PASS for supplied geometry — cards are at least 169x243px, Parent Mode 174x52px, PIN at least 286x66px, Cancel at least 286x48px. Actual touch/keyboard behavior is untested.

coverage_receipt.FINAL_RESULT: PASS / CLEAN within nine-capture visual scope
